controles.affirmation: Le resultat de souscription du segment assurance est tombe a 27 M$ au T2 2026 contre 129 M$ un an plus tot (-79%), ratio combine de 93,4% a 98,5%
controles.verbatim_source: "Our insurance segment reported $27 million of underwriting income for the 2026 second quarter" ; tableau segment : Underwriting income (loss) $27 / $129 / (79.1) ; Combined ratio 98.5% / 93.4% / 5.1 (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Recul attribue a la non-reconduction du portefeuille MCE Allianz et a la pression tarifaire concurrentielle E&S property
controles.verbatim_source: "These opportunities were partially offset by our decision not to renew certain middle market commercial program business which we acquired from Allianz in 2024 (the “MCE Acquisition”) along with a reduction in E&S property business due to competitive rate pressure."

controles.affirmation: Les obligations senior passent de 2 729 M$ a 4 286 M$ (+57%), "portees par une nouvelle emission publique de 600 M$ en juin 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: "On June 9, 2026, Arch Capital completed a public offering of $600 million aggregate principal amount of 5.250% senior notes due 2036 (the “2036 Notes”) and $1.4 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.950% senior notes due 2056" ; "Cash used for financing activities ... reflected the issuance of $2.0 billion of senior notes, partially offset by tender offer activity of $398 million" (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: L'emission de juin 2026 porte sur 2,0 Mds$ au total (600 M$ a echeance 2036 + 1,4 Md$ a echeance 2056), partiellement compensee par 398 M$ d'offres de rachat. La citation de l'ATT est tronquee exactement a "$600 million aggregate principal amount", ce qui supprime la tranche de 1,4 Md$ et rend l'explication du +1 557 M$ arithmetiquement incoherente.

controles.affirmation: 1 949 M$ de rachats d'actions au S1 2026, soit environ 94% du resultat net
controles.verbatim_source: "Through the first half of the year, we have repurchased approximately 94% of our net income in our own shares." ; flux de financement : (1,949) (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Valeur comptable par action de 59,17 $ a 68,04 $ (+15%)
controles.verbatim_source: "Book value per share was $68.04 at June 30, 2026, compared to $66.19 at March 31, 2026, and $59.17 at June 30, 2025."

controles.affirmation: Primes nettes emises reassurance -10% a 1 844 M$, pression tarifaire et retentions plus elevees des cedantes
controles.verbatim_source: "Net premiums written were $1.8 billion, down roughly 10% when compared to the 2025 second quarter, reflecting pricing pressures and higher retentions by cedants in certain property and short-tail lines along with targeted increased retrocessions." ; tableau : 1,844 / 2,059

controles.affirmation: Les modeles de catastrophe reposent sur des hypotheses sujettes a erreur ; reserves nettes 34 775 M$ (+3,7% depuis fin 2025)
controles.verbatim_source: "All of the catastrophe modeling tools that we use or rely on to evaluate our catastrophe exposures are therefore based on significant assumptions and judgments and are subject to error and misestimation. As a result, our estimated exposures could be materially different than our actual results." (10-K FY2025) ; bilan : 34,775 vs 33,547

controles.affirmation: "Une nouvelle procedure judiciaire ou reglementaire materielle apparait, alors qu'aucune n'etait en cours au 30 juin 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: "We, in common with the insurance industry in general, are subject to litigation and arbitration in the normal course of our business. As of June 30, 2026, we were not a party to any litigation or arbitration which is expected by management to have a material adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition and liquidity." (Item 1 Legal Proceedings et note 15)
controles.correction_proposee: Arch declare etre partie a des litiges et arbitrages dans le cours normal de ses activites. Reformuler : "aucune procedure dont la direction attende un effet defavorable significatif n'etait declaree au 30 juin 2026" — et non "aucune procedure n'etait en cours".

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres totaux : "progressent plus lentement, de 24 206 M$ a 24 030 M$"
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total shareholders' equity available to Arch" 24,030 (30/06/2026) vs 24,206 (31/12/2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Les capitaux propres reculent (-0,7%), ils ne "progressent" pas ; et il s'agit des capitaux propres part du groupe ("available to Arch"), pas des capitaux propres totaux. Les chiffres eux-memes sont exacts.
